title: FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### What version of Next.js are you using?

10.2.3

### What version of Node.js are you using?

14.15.0

### What browser are you using?

Chrome

### What operating system are you using?

macOS big sur 11.4

### How are you deploying your application?

next dev

### Describe the Bug



```
  npm run dev
 "dev": "NODE_OPTIONS=\"--max_old_space_size=4096\" next dev"
```

```
> NODE_OPTIONS="--max_old_space_size=4096" next dev

ready - started server on 0.0.0.0:3000, url: http://localhost:3000
info  - Using webpack 5. Reason: no next.config.js https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/webpack5
event - compiled successfully
event - build page: /
wait  - compiling...
event - compiled successfully

<--- Last few GCs --->

[1804:0x1046c6000]   118760 ms: Mark-sweep (reduce) 4090.4 (4101.8) -> 4090.4 (4102.8) MB, 4605.2 / 0.0 ms  (average mu = 0.198, current mu = 0.169) allocation failure GC in old space requested


<--- JS stacktrace --->

FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
 1: 0x1012e2ba5 node::Abort() (.cold.1) [/usr/local/bin/node]

```

### Expected Behavior



```
ready - started server on 0.0.0.0:3000, url: http://localhost:3000
info  - Using webpack 5. Reason: no next.config.js https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/webpack5
event - compiled successfully
wait  - compiling...
event - compiled successfully
event - build page: /
wait  - compiling...
event - compiled successfully
```

but gets `FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory`

### To Reproduce

Error seem to exist in previous versions, I'm unsure of exact cause.

1. npx create-next-app app-name
2. add some components
3. randomly happened
